info.title: CareCircle API
info.description: Elder-care platform: face-ID login, medicine reminders with camera confirmation, 6-hourly AI health check-ins, risk scoring, pharmacy ordering and family alerts.

post.description: Create an account. Patients must give at least one emergency contact (name + mobile).
Frontend sends the 128-number face descriptor; we return a token if it matches an enrolled face.

parameters.name: q

schema.description: prefix or part of the name; 'A' = names starting with A

parameters.description: prefix or part of the name; 'A' = names starting with A

get.description: Doctors and relatives: the patients they are allowed to see.
One call = everything the dashboard needs.

post.description: Give a relative (or doctor) permission to see your dashboard. They get access when they register with this email/phone.
Patient or their doctor adds a medicine and the times of day (e.g. ["08:00","20:00"]).
DEMO helper: make a dose due right now so you can show the reminder + camera flow on stage.

get.description: The frontend polls this every ~30s: what must the elder do RIGHT NOW? (doses, check-in, appointments)

post.description:
Patient confirms they took the tablet (optionally uploading the short camera clip/photo as proof).
Tablets in the same time slot must be confirmed one after another, in order.

get.description: What the check-in screen should ask. Render these as big buttons / read them aloud.

post.description: Used by the 6-hourly prompt, the after-tablets prompt and the voice assistant.
Yes -> the agent orders the suggested medicine from a pharmacy. No -> the family is notified.
Send the voice transcript. Returns what to say (reply) and what the UI should do (action).

get.description: Demo helper: shows the SMS/calls that were sent (or simulated) for this user's patients.

post.description: Patient, relative or doctor can book. Reminders are sent 24h and 1h before (scheduler).
Log walking (km), exercise (minutes) or a trip (km).

get.description: Exercise, walking target, food and travel-distance guidance, adapted to the latest risk score.
